title: LOWZ pre-reconstruction released power, window and covariance target

scopes.title: One LOWZ P0/P2 source-conditioned pipeline target
scopes.checked_claim: The June2016 release selects PRE-RECON LOWZ P0/P2 at zeff0.32, with k in h Mpc^-1 and P/error in(Mpc/h)^3. Its cited original1509.06386v2 supplies the discrete four-block window action: W00/W02 contribute to measured monopole and W20/W22 to measured quadrupole, with data rows and input-grid columns. It assumes only monopole/quadrupole angular shape; the cited action has no additional quadrature factor. Source historical lower cuts are P0 k>0.02 and P2 k>0.04 h Mpc^-1, with published table fits at kmax0.24. The fixed analysis fiducial, eight fitted parameters, Poisson-departure nuisance and mock-derived Gaussian-fit assumption are located source conditioning. Central structural inspection reports53-row data,1000-point input grid, four53×1000 blocks and106×106 covariance; only6/106 diagonal/error intervals match the candidate P0-then-P2 order.
scopes.unresolved: Released covariance axis/diagonal ownership remains unresolved; the paper block convention does not repair the6/106 result. Exact cut-row map, finite-mock correction ownership, window calibration/normalization ancestry, nuisance priors and galaxy/RSD model with CLASS unit/epoch/support/AP mapping require a separately accepted adapter. Source Gaussian assumption is not an observed statistical law. No prediction, solve, fit or installed caller is accepted.

limitations: One released LOWZ power-only target is selected. Its galaxy multipoles are reductions conditioned on catalogues, selection, randoms, fiducial geometry and mocks; they are not a direct matter spectrum or independent amplitude measurement. This is not a Planck or historical full-shape-fit reproduction.

The primary discrete window action and release row/column roles are located. Higher angular multipoles are excluded by the source approximation; integral-constraint correction is omitted. Window-calibration dependence, literal index/normalization ambiguities in the preceding primary expression and missing HTML equation-number tags are preserved. No new weights, transpose, renormalization or source repair is inferred.

All53 supplied bins differ from the historical fit selection: P0 k>0.02, P2 k>0.04, reported table fits kmax0.24 h Mpc^-1. README nominal0.0015–0.3 support differs from the central inspected data endpoints0.002342–0.317660; the two descriptions do not determine the exact fit-row selection.

Structural shape/finite-token inspection is not covariance validity or producer ownership. Under the candidate all-P0-then-P2 order, only6 of106 covariance diagonals match the printed-error-square intervals. The central Every diagonal matches sentence was withdrawn additively. Covariance axis/error reconciliation remains blocked; no permutation, rescaling, substitute diagonal covariance or likelihood is accepted.

Original analysis uses a fixed fiducial spectral shape and eight free parameters, with non-Poisson shot-noise and Fingers-of-God freedom. Exact nuisance priors, historical galaxy/RSD implementation, finite-mock correction ownership and compatibility with a changing CLASS full-state model remain open. A simple bias/RSD choice would require a distinct declared approximation.

Any native Gaussian target must declare a conditional statistical model and exact ordered common-unit residual/covariance. Copied native source provides whole-matrix preparation and whole-residual evaluation, not galaxy/window physics, observed Gaussian law or installed/compiled target acceptance. Continuous CMB projection geometry supplies no matter/window adapter.

Shared BOSS objects, randoms, masks, mocks and fiducial geometry imply dependent analysis ancestry. Cross-covariance with other BOSS, BAO or compressed products remains unknown. Public source access and citation requests do not establish redistribution rights. No full-paper stage, scientific qualification or numerical experiment is promoted.
Next action: the source/consumer owner reconciles exact released covariance axes/error semantics and the historical cut map, or retains refusal, before scoring.
